# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting F4code or F4code-operated infrastructure to
[security@f4code.dev](mailto:security@f4code.dev). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://f4code.dev/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
